purpose: Exact inverse mappings for approved shared contracts only. No style recipe, user source or arbitrary prompt line is normalized.

entries.name: EXPRESSIVE_DIRECTION
entries.current: EXPRESSIVE DIRECTION: clear/lively manga; bold height/tilt/foreshortening, full-body exaggeration, weight/silhouette/faces. Actual Camera/Action; speed lines never substitute for motion/perspective. Optional directional motion blur: scripted motion path; focal action/contact/text readable; never invent motion in still scenes. No default eye-level tableau. Build panel contrast: scale/light/VFX. Keep explicit quiet beats, Camera/Action, identity, verbatim dialogue, limbs, prop ownership/facing; exaggeration is not a drawing defect.

entries.name: PANEL_EDGE_CONTINUITY_LOCK
entries.current: PANEL EDGE CONTINUITY LOCK: PAGE CONTAINMENT: keep all four outer frame sides and corners fully inside the canvas with a visible margin; never crop or expand the page past the image edge. Explicit borderless/full-bleed layout wins. Internal panel breakout never authorizes cropping the outer page. Props/screens/lettering stay in their own panel; no spill into the next scene unless explicitly scripted. Default to keeping each visible head and complete hair silhouette inside its panel with clear headroom. When a panel-border breakthrough is artistically motivated, render it only as one deliberate continuous foreground layer: the border line stops behind the complete head/hair silhouette and resumes after it. Never run a border through the face or hair, sever the silhouette, duplicate an outside fragment, or shift the inside and outside segments. If a clean breakthrough cannot be rendered, keep the complete silhouette inside the panel.

entries.name: RICH_PANEL_COMPOSITION_LOCK
entries.current:
RICH PANEL COMPOSITION / CHARACTER CLARITY LOCK:
- Keep story-required physical setting cues and interaction props; vary background detail with the page's reading rhythm instead of imposing the same object count on every panel.
- Panel VFX follow scripted staging. Explicit abstract beats may omit background scenery; never remove story evidence, interaction props or action contacts.
- Keep focal speaker/reaction partner/main action readable; clarity never requires every face/hand/prop sharp.
- In physical-setting shots retain environmental shapes, light masses and perspective; nonfocal near/far planes may blur or use thinner/paler detail. Equal depths share focus; required text, contacts and reactions stay readable; explicit deep focus and abstract style win.
- Use negative space and selective detail for quiet beats while keeping the physical setting and spatial continuity. Do not replace a setting with a blank backdrop merely because the beat is quiet; preserve explicit scripted abstraction.

Explicit deep focus wins; scripted abstraction may omit scenery, not required props; no default blank backdrop.

entries.name: SCENE_LETTERING_LOCK
entries.current: SCENE LETTERING: scripted object text exact/readable; repeat only if scripted. Otherwise keep natural artwork/icons/colors/borders/material/layout and any context-appropriate lettering, length/density/readability. No censoring/blanking/simplifying just for unscripted text; depth blur/thin/pale allowed, required text readable.
entries.previous: SCENE LETTERING: explicit per-panel object text exact/readable; repeat only if scripted. Unspecified posters, signs, packages, menus/book covers keep natural artwork/pictograms/colors/borders/material/layout. Freely render context-appropriate lettering—readable/decorative, short/long, any amount/density. Never suppress, simplify, blank, grey, blur, pixelate, mosaic or censor a surface merely because text is unscripted.
